notes: Full price = Norce's PriceStandard on the order line (the RRP ex VAT on ~99 % of lines). Offer line = sold ≥1 % under it after markdown and code discount; note that most of the range carries a standing markdown, so 'full price' is the minority even outside campaigns. Depth = 1 − paid ÷ standard price; markdown and code parts split by the line's DiscountAmount. Gross of returns and cancellations, like the rest of the Norce data.

GP2 = Norce line revenue − current SKU cost (norce.sku_costs; uncosted lines take the costed lines' margin) − the market's GP1→GP2 cost per order from the Funnel export (last 28 days), spread over an order's lines by revenue. Returns sit inside that per-order cost, so offer and full-price lines carry the same return cost; if offer items are returned more, offer GP2 is overstated.

Stock is one shared pool for Babyshop and Lekmer (Channable feed units_for_sale), so days of cover use sales in ALL markets and both brands. A SKU that sold in the last 14 days but is missing from the feed counts as sold out (Channable drops out-of-stock items). 'Short by Cyber Monday' = units needed at today's pace until Black Week, then at last year's Black Week multiple of that pace (LY Black Week units/day ÷ the same 14-day window a year earlier), minus stock.

Shopping spend counts as 'out of stock' only for days the SKU was out of stock: from the daily stock snapshot (norce.bm_stock_daily, first snapshot of the day, from 4 Nov) and no sale that day; before that, inferred as 'out of stock now and after its last Norce sale'. Spend that sold the last units is not counted. 'Sells out before Black Week' = in stock now, days of cover below the days left to 23 Nov at the 14-day pace.
Depth and scope of calendar offers are parsed from the campaign name and brief: the calendar has no depth field. Realised depth in the tables is what customers actually got.

Lekmer: same catalogue and stock as Babyshop (shared Norce PartNos, one Channable feed); Lekmer has no FI Google Ads account. The campaign calendar holds only one Lekmer campaign (LM - Autumn Days, ended 15 Oct), so Lekmer offers show as none.
